title: Tenant GPU Seat Mapping and Allocation Scenarios — Aug 2026
summary: Working sheet for mapping per-tenant GPU "seat" allocations (logical unit of reserved GPU capacity) across zones and contracts. Includes baseline allocations, projected utilization by workload class, and two phased reallocation scenarios that reconcile overcommit targets vs SLA-backed reservations.
content:
Sheet: Tenant seat mapping (rows = reservations)

Columns:
Contract ID, Customer (short), Tenant ID, Region, AZ/Zone, GPU Type, Seat Unit (vGPU-equivalent), Seats Reserved (count), Monthly Reserved Hours, SLO Tier, Utilization Target (%), Observed 30d Avg Util (%), Planned Allocation Policy, Fallback Pool, Effective Start, Effective End, Notes

Rows:
CT-4041, EpochAI, t-epoch-12, us-west1, us-west1-a, A100-80GB, 1.0, 24, 720, gold, 75, 62, pinned, shared-burst-1, 2026-09-01, 2027-08-31, customer committed flat 24x, needs padding for peak batch windows
CT-4120, NovaDocs, t-nova-3, eu-west1, eu-west1-b, H100-80GB, 1.5, 4, 120, standard, 60, 28, flexible, overflow-pool-eu, 2026-08-01, 2026-12-31, short-term trial, expected ramp if usage > 50% for 2 months
CT-3999, MedSecure, t-med-8, us-east1, us-east1-c, A100-80GB, 0.5, 96, 2880, platinum, 85, 91, reserved-highprio, fallback-none, 2026-05-01, 2029-04-30, HIPAA customer; strict isolation requested
CT-4217, RetailPulse, t-ret-22, ap-southeast1, ap-southeast1-a, T4-16GB, 0.25, 200, 6000, bronze, 40, 12, bursty, shared-burst-2, 2026-07-15, 2027-07-14, mostly embedding workloads, tolerant to preemption
CT-4302, FinAlpha, t-fin-1, eu-central1, eu-central1-a, H100-80GB, 2.0, 8, 240, gold, 80, 78, pinned, shared-burst-1, 2026-10-01, 2027-09-30, latency-sensitive fine-tuning windows monthly
CT-4375, EdgeML, t-edge-5, us-west2, us-west2-a, A100-80GB, 0.75, 40, 1200, standard, 65, 33, flexible, overflow-pool-us, 2026-08-10, 2027-02-10, expect seasonality (holiday spikes)
CT-4019, AdsLab, t-ads-2, us-west1, us-west1-b, A10G-24GB, 0.2, 450, 13500, bronze, 35, 18, bursty, shared-burst-3, 2026-06-01, 2027-05-31, low-latency but very high fanout traffic
CT-4450, BioGenix, t-bio-14, eu-north1, eu-north1-a, H100-80GB, 1.0, 12, 360, platinum, 88, 94, reserved-highprio, fallback-none, 2026-04-01, 2028-03-31, long-running model evals, sustained high utilization

Computed columns (manual calc notes):
- Monthly Reserved Hours = Seats Reserved * 30 days * 24 hours (rounded)
- Observed 30d Avg Util (%) is sampled from telemetry (notes: telemetry lag may undercount startup usage)
- Capacity headroom target per region = sum(reserved seats) * (1 - average utilization target) * safety-factor(1.08)

Scenario simulations (assumptions and outputs)
Scenario A — Aggressive pooling (target lower economic unit cost)
Assumptions: 10% overcommit allowed for bronze/standard tiers, gold/platinum pinned strictly, allow cross-AZ failover for flexible policies, enable preemption on bursty classes.
Simulated 6-month outcome (using historical diurnal + monthly seasonality):
- Total reserved seats across us-west1 reduced by 8% via consolidation of low-util bronze seats into shared-burst pools.
- Estimated monthly cost savings: ~13% on instance rental at current sku mix.
- Risk: 6% probability of soft-SLA incidents for customers with gold tier during peak due to AZ failover delay (mitigation: staggered canary and warm standby).

Scenario B — Conservative isolation (customer SLAs prioritized)
Assumptions: No overcommit for gold/platinum; maintain AZ-locality for pinned contracts; create dedicated cold-standby for top 5% customers.
Simulated 6-month outcome:
- Us-east1 reserved seat count increases 2.4% to accommodate cold standby for high-value customers.
- Estimated monthly cost delta: +7% compared to current baseline.
- Benefit: SLA incident probability reduced to <0.5% across all tiers.

Hotspots and region notes:
- us-west1: high concentration of bronze and bursty seats (EpochAI + AdsLab). Recommend creating a second overflow-pool-us capacity bucket in us-west1-b to smooth peak preemption.
- eu-west1: several short-term trials (NovaDocs) — propose converting short trials to burst-only reservations with automated decommit triggers at 30% sustained underutilization for 2 weeks.
- ap-southeast1: primarily embedding workloads on smaller SKUs; can be consolidated into multi-tenant inference clusters to reduce fragmentation.

Outstanding questions (to resolve before Q4 planning):
- What is the acceptable cross-AZ failover time window for gold-tier customers? (SRE/Console to define observable SLOs)
- Should we allow fractional seat sizing below 0.25 for experimental customers to reduce fragmentation? (Product decision)
- Budget sign-off for cold-standby pool sizing for top 10 contracts (Finance needs risk model)

Action items / next steps:
- [Infra] Build small POC to validate shared-burst-1 pool preemption impact on MedSecure in us-east1 (owner: Arjun) — target finish 2026-08-25.
- [Product] Define fractional-seat UX and billing implications (owner: Leah) — draft policy 2026-09-03.
- [SRE] Propose AZ failover SLOs for gold tier and create alerting playbook (owner: Jonah) — review meeting 2026-08-20.
- [Finance] Run cost-risk model for cold-standby sizing for top 10 accounts (owner: Maya) — deliverable 2026-09-10.

Appendix: quick formulas and telemetry pointers
- Telemetry query: telemetry.gpu_utilization.30d_avg grouped by tenant_id (note: use last 14 days for smoothing)
- Seat unit equivalency: H100-80GB = 2.0 seat units for heavy fine-tune jobs, A100-80GB = 1.0 seat, T4-16GB = 0.25 seat, A10G = 0.2 seat
- Safety factors used in sim: consolidation headroom 1.08, emergency buffer 1.12 for platinum tier

Notes to reviewers:
- This sheet is intentionally conservative in reported observed utilization (telemetry lag). Please flag any tenants with upcoming renewals that may change committed quantities.
- If accepted, we will formalize seat definitions and bake them into the invoices and the Dedicated capacity UI (product ticket linked).

End of sheet
